    CHAPTER I

He said -- and then stopped short -- that he would go no further.

There was a stand - alone hyphen sitting here in the middle of it.

The well-known captain of the vessel came aboard at half past ten.
He stopped—then went on again as though nothing at all had passed.
The years 1850–1860 were the busiest that the harbour ever knew.
As soon as Mr. —— had left the ship the crew began to talk of it.

He paused at the door and looked back at her before he went out—
